notes_for_editor: Fate disputed and unresolved: firelookout.com says offered for sale and removed in 1950; Forest Lookouts and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed. Elevation also disagrees (firelookout.com 2983 ft, Idaho Fire Lookouts 3983 ft); left out of the story. The 1941 name William Heard appears only on Idaho Fire Lookouts and may or may not be the 1944 William Hoard. No source found on what remains or on public access; the one web search added nothing. Record's 1950 destroyed event is kept; a removal event was added from firelookout.com. Fact check 2026-10-10: the 1941 year sits on the Idaho Fire Lookouts page as a heading above Heard's name; the story now says the pages do not show whether Heard and Hoard are the same man.
